svg.title: CodeFlow
svg.desc: CodeFlow (AnshulMohanty/Code_Flow). Maps how a codebase fits together. Eight stages from git clone to a map you can question. Answers cite real files and lines, and a line that was never read cannot be cited.
svg.text: Maps how a codebase fits together.
Eight stages from git clone to a map you can
question. Answers cite real files and lines, and a
line that was never read cannot be cited.

ask // what breaks if I change auth/session?
